summary: CGI Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, furnishing its Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) and unaudited consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended June 30, 2026, along with a related press release. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, comparable to a domestic Form 10-Q or 8-K earnings release. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. It is purely an operational and financial update. No deal terms are applicable.
